description:
# BadFella Patches v1.0.0

Initial release of BadFella Patches for TickTick 8.2.4.0.

- Client-side Premium features and limits.
- Scheduled reminder compatibility.
- Firebase certificate compatibility, including Android 17 token setup.
- Reduced declared analytics collection and disabled legacy Google Analytics startup.
- Monkey source icon and concise Morphe setup instructions.

Server-side AI access and extra-list cloud sync are not granted. Local-only list organization and backup are not included in this release.
